== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tractor Beam (Japanese)|Tractor Beam]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157709597/SvhrTsbj00eFkhKpeWoE7Q.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 90960101.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0919995e55e45c74423e88e9c6a6377a04f09431e31b6fe93407003ad2feabbc</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
